answer: An atlas service forecasting each harbor zephyr can limit rewards with unforgeable, single-use customer demand tokens. A customer receives tokens only after independently verified service use, and each token funds a fixed payout shared by every agent fulfilling that request. Replay protection rejects duplicate redemption. Creating more agent names cannot create demand or enlarge the payout. An attacker must purchase additional real service use at a cost above its reward, making self-dealing through aliases a loss.
